name: Capri Global Capital Ltd
title: Capri Global Capital Ltd - 531595 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Capri Global's Q4 FY26 shows record PAT of INR283 crore and gross Stage 3 down to 0.9%, but the read is growth-led, with gold mix rising to 46% and a 350-branch gold expansion, so supply-side discipline is absent.

triggers.label: FY27 PAT guidance INR1,300 crore
triggers.quote: we have given the PAT guidance for next year or FY '27 at about INR1,300 crores.

triggers.label: Gold yield down 90 bps sequentially
triggers.quote: Our yields on gold loan have again dropped sequentially by 90 bps.

triggers.label: Gold AUM up 33% QoQ
triggers.quote: Gold loan AUM saw robust growth to INR16,965 crores, a sequential increase of 33% quarter-on-quarter

triggers.label: Co-lending volume slowdown from new RBI norms
triggers.quote: there could be a temporary slowdown in co-lending volume for a couple of quarters

guidance.quote: we are giving a guidance of INR46,000 crores by end of FY '27 and about INR57,000 crores by FY '28
So we revised FY '28 guidance by about INR2,000 crores.
we have given the PAT guidance for next year or FY '27 at about INR1,300 crores.
return on average assets to 4% to 4.5% by FY '28
sustainable return on average equity of 16% to 18%
I think we should be able to do about 10 to 20 bps reduction. This year, we are not expecting much cost of borrowing going down.
sustainable basis, our credit costs will remain by and large, in the range of 0.7%.
This year, we should be able to add about 350 branches in gold loan alone
Gold loan mix can reach to about 50%.

prior_guidance_check.quote: gold loan mix looks like the way we are operating and opening more branches. Gold loan mix can reach to about 50%.
Our yields on gold loan have again dropped sequentially by 90 bps.

prior_guidance_check.metric: AUM target INR55,000 crore by FY28
prior_guidance_check.quote: we are on track to achieve an AUM of INR55,000 crores by FY '28

red_flags.label: Gold LTV 70% on new disbursements with gold price volatility
red_flags.quote: on the new disbursement, LTV is about 70%.

red_flags.label: Co-lending gold share falling; yield dilution
red_flags.quote: the co-lending AUM in the gold loan segment has reduced sequentially from 39-odd percent to 31%

red_flags.label: Stage 2 still 2.8%; credit cost overlay
red_flags.quote: management overlay of INR16 crores to account for evolving macroeconomic conditions

evasions.topic: Credit rating upgrade timing and cost-of-funds impact
evasions.quote: it depends on various other factors, and it doesn't remain in our complete control.
